---
title: "Co-enrichment of nucleolar (NPM1) and speckle (SRRM2) NuFANCI"
output: html_notebook
---

Scatter plot of protein log2 fold changes (NuFANCI vs input) for the nucleolar NPM1 sort (x) against the speckle SRRM2 sort (y), coloured by significance in each comparison.

**Input:** `dual_comparison_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_Input_and_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_Input.tsv` (FragPipe-Analyst dual comparison; in `results/`).
**Output:** `protein_srrm2_vs_nucleoli.pdf`.


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
# setwd("path/to/data")  # folder with the input tables (see header)
df <- read_tsv("dual_comparison_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_Input_and_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_Input.tsv")
```

```{r}

# Rename columns for convenience
colnames(df)[colnames(df) == "log2FC_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_Input"]   <- "x"
colnames(df)[colnames(df) == "log2FC_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_Input"] <- "y"

# Genes to label
genes_to_label <- c("NPM1", "SRRM2", "FBL", "SON", "POLR2A", "POLR1G", "NOL10")

# Count points per status (for labels), excluding NAs on either axis
status_counts <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(x) | !is.na(y)) %>%
  count(status) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(status, "\n(n = ", n, ")"))

# Merge counts back for legend labels
df <- df %>%
  left_join(status_counts %>% select(status, label), by = "status")

# Define colors per status
status_colors <- c(
  "Both significant"                                          = "#E63946",
  "Only NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_NPM1_Input"   = "#457B9D",
  "Only NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_FANCI_vs_NUCL_HCT116_SRRM2_Input" = "#2A9D8F",
  "Not significant"                                           = "grey70"
)

# Build label-to-color mapping
label_colors <- setNames(
  status_colors[status_counts$status],
  status_counts$label
)

# Subset of rows to label
df_labels <- df %>%
  filter(name %in% genes_to_label, !is.na(x), !is.na(y))

# Plot (Not significant first so colored points render on top)
df_ordered <- df %>%
  arrange(status == "Not significant")
```
```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
p <- ggplot(df_ordered, aes(x = x, y = y, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data        = df_labels,
    aes(label   = name),
    color       = "black",
    size        = 3,
    fontface    = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    segment.size  = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = label_colors, name = "Status") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(
    x     = "log2FC  NPM1 FANCI vs NPM1 Input",
    y     = "log2FC  SRRM2 FANCI vs SRRM2 Input",
    title = "Dual comparison scatter plot"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) + theme(aspect.ratio=1)

print(p)
ggsave("protein_srrm2_vs_nucleoli.pdf")
```
